name: Legendary Order of the Beyond
body:
A legendary cavalier who belongs to this order follows principles far past normal understanding, drawing inspiration from the planes and those who dwell within.

Edicts: Legendary Cavaliers of the Order of the Beyond must select one component of their alignment as well as a type of outsider (such as angel or devil) who shares that alignment. They must do their best to emulate that outsider and follow their alignment. The legendary cavalier lives their life to fulfill the goals and desires of their chosen alignment and outsider.

Signature Skill: Knowledge (the planes)

Unique Aura: Aligned Weapon: All allies treat their attacks as though they were the legendary cavalier’s chosen alignment for the purpose of penetrating damage reduction.

Legendary Classes: Sword and Fist © 2022, Legendary Games; Authors: Jason Nelson, N. Jolly, Alex Augunas, Jesse Benner, Siobhan Bjorknas, Clinton J.
